text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I got some fish mint... Now to mash it<n>all up before it
dries out... Oh, almost<n>forgot the healing charm!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Lizard, fish—chameleon! ☆

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Without warning, an unbearably<n>pungent stench
starts wafting from<n>my mouth—so I spring out of
bed!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Oh... you're up.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: You woke uuuuup!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
As I pat the back of the small figure<n>clinging to me, I
realize that she<n>must've carried me after I
collapsed...<n>And then jammed my mouth full of<n>fish
mint.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Leaving that aside, she may be<n>young, but she's
still an<n>Umamusume—her grip is certainly<n>nothing to
scoff at. To be honest, my<n>spine might be at its
limit...
choice_data_list: Um, Sweep... That kind of hurts—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Nope! I'm not moving. I don't care if it<n>hurts. Just
deal with it, you dummy!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Sniff.
choice_data_list: I'm sorry for making you worry.
I'm sorry for making you worry.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Huh?! I wasn't worried about you at<n>all! Actually, I
was mad! Super, duper<n>mad!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
You're my familiar! But then you<n>collapsed! And
gave me a shock! And<n>wouldn't answer me!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Honestly, are you, like, the world's<n>biggest
dummy?! A familiar should<n>never, ever, EVER
cause trouble for<n>their magical girl!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
...I also made three big bottles of fish<n>mint tea and
squeezed them in the<n>fridge.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Listen up, okay?! You better drink all<n>of it, or I won't
forgive you! 'Cause<n>I'll be coming by to check on
your<n>progress!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
On the surface, Sweep Tosho is<n>trembling with
anger. But at the same<n>time, I also feel an equal
amount of<n>kindness underneath.
choice_data_list: You got it, I'll drink it all.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Hmph. As long as you understand,<n>and you better!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
A few days pass, and we're back to<n>training. What
selfish whim will<n>Sweep demand of me today, I
wond—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Hey, familiar. Y'know, back when I<n>beat those two
in that race, it felt<n>really good.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
It was the same when I first met you.<n>I was tired of
being ordered around,<n>so I tried ignoring it all and
just ran<n>the way I wanted to... And it felt kinda<n>good.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
It was nice. It kinda made me feel—I<n>mean, only a
teensy tiny bit—like this<n>might be fun.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: It made me realize that running theway I want to run... might be fun.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
And you—you said my running was<n>magical, didn't
you?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: I see... I think I get it now.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Hey, you asked me before, didn't<n>you? If I wanted
to see what the<n>world of racing truly had to offer?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Hey, you asked me before, didn't<n>you? If I wanted
to see what the<n>world of racing truly had to offer?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
What did you mean by that? Why do<n>you think I'll
find my magic there? I<n>wanna know more, so tell
me.
choice_data_list: Rather than telling you, it's faster to just show you!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
The next weekend, I bring Sweep to<n>Kyoto
Racecourse. The stands are<n>packed with spectators
impatiently<n>waiting for the start of a big race.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Imagine? About what?
choice_data_list: Imagine yourself running in front of this crowd.
Imagine yourself running in front of this crowd.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
The deafening cheers of the fans,<n>feet speeding
over fresh turf—your<n>rivals are right there, none of
them<n>here to lose. The race just keeps on<n>heating
up.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Luck, talent, and skill. Even with all<n>three, victory
isn't certain, but you<n>know this. Grabbing this
once-in-a-lifetime chance, you burst<n>across the
finish...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Hmmm.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I see. That does sound a teensy bit<n>fun, if you ask
me.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: ...Hmm.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Okay, I've made up my mind. I'll give<n>running a try.
I'll believe in you.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: To the Twinkle Series we go, in<n>search of magic!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I mean, if I just keep on running my<n>own fun way, I
might find the magic<n>I'm looking for. Right?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I'll trust in my familiar. 'Cause I'm a<n>genius
magical girl with a biiig heart! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
At long last, she's made the decision<n>to run all by
herself! Trying my best to<n>hold back tears of joy, I
calm myself<n>and change gears.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
She's got the makings of a star.<n>From now on,
we'll work hand in<n>hand and train twice as hard!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: ...Or at least, that's what I thought.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
First things first—sweets! Today I'm<n>feeling scones.
Grandma ate these a<n>lot, y'know. They're perfect
for a<n>pick-me-up!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I better see you eating too, okay? Fill<n>up your
tummy so you don't flop<n>over like last time.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
After all, you're my familiar—now and<n>forever!
You're gonna be helping me<n>out for a looong, long
time.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Got it? ...Hey, where's my answer?!
